metadata.description: word-master skill — template-driven, contract-locked Word document production line

plugins.name: word-master
plugins.description: Generate a natively editable DOCX whose every format decision comes from a unit template contract: headings, captions, tables and numbering are applied by deterministic builder scripts and verified by a fail-closed quality gate. Note: run `pip install -r requirements.txt` inside the installed plugin directory for the Python scripts to work.
